sloka: इति एवम् उक्त्वा मदन अभिपीडितःस लक्ष्मणम् वाक्यम् अनन्य चेतनः ।विवेश पंपाम् नलिनी मनो रमाम्तम् उत्तमम् शोकम् उदीरयाणः ॥३-७५-२९॥
transliteration: iti evam uktvā madana abhipīḍitaḥsa lakṣmaṇam vākyam ananya cetanaḥ ।viveśa paṁpām nalinī mano ramāmtam uttamam śokam udīrayāṇaḥ ॥3-75-29॥

translations.english: Having said these words to Lakshmana who was listening to him with undivided attention, Rama, the best of the Raghus, oppressed by love and afflicted by tears of grief entered Pampa, the delightful lotuslake.
